facts.fact: 秋季学期将尽，Emily 圣诞要离开四周；Aiden 把这四周想成刑期。
facts.anchor: Autumn term would soon be over, then Emily would be gone. She would disappear over Christmas for four long weeks

facts.fact: 他在最后一堂研讨课结束时没有留住她的具体计划，但知道必须做点什么。
facts.anchor: He lacked a concrete plan to detain the girl at the end of their final seminar but knew he had to try something.

facts.fact: 下课后 Emily 照例慢吞吞、费很大劲地收拾书和笔，等其他人走光。
facts.anchor: she carried out her usual performance of packing up her books and pens slowly and laboriously

facts.fact: Aiden 提议新年夜装头痛，推掉妻子朋友的乏味派对去见她。
facts.anchor: ‘New Year’s Eve. Friends have invited us to a boring party, but they’re more her friends really.

facts.fact: Emily 说室友 Matty 和 JJ 想让她回 Leeds 跨年，她还没决定。
facts.anchor: ‘Matty and JJ want me to come back to Leeds for it. I haven’t made up my mind.’

facts.fact: 他把她的地址写在马尼拉信封背面，说会把深蓝色沃尔沃停在最近的横街。
facts.anchor: He scribbled her address on the back of a manila envelope. ‘I’ll park on the nearest side street.

facts.fact: 他向她讨一张照片，说分开的日子里好有个念想。
facts.anchor: ‘I’d love a photo of you. Something for me to remember you by during our time apart.’

facts.fact: 他最后又索要一条她的内裤，她的笑淡了一点。
facts.anchor: ‘One more thing, if I may,’ he said. ‘I’d also like a pair of your panties.’
